'''Malketh''' was a [[Kriek]] and [[kulai]] advisor to the leader of the [[Kherkhaman]], [[Kavakoderakanbnuarria]]. Naturally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Malketh was believed to be this living voice of the [[Deity/Legends|god]] [[Br'lai]].<ref name="Scout" />
